name: RaoMusic
description: Generates full songs with vocals, instrumentals and sound effects from a text idea or the user's own lyrics, across seven music engines (Suno, Google Lyria, Mureka, MiniMax, ACE-Step, YuE, ElevenLabs). Tools quote the exact credit cost before generating, start generations with an idempotency key, poll status and return download links. Generations spend credits from the user's RaoMusic account.
author: RaoMusic
